name: terrascan
description: Infrastructure as Code security scanner that detects compliance and security violations in Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and more

terrascan.description: Comprehensive IaC security scanner for detecting misconfigurations, compliance violations, and security risks before cloud provisioning
terrascan.usage:
terrascan scan -t terraform -d /path/to/terraform
terrascan scan -t k8s -d /path/to/k8s
terrascan scan -t terraform --iac-file main.tf
terrascan scan -t aws-cft --iac-file template.yaml
terrascan scan -o json --output-file results.json
terrascan init
